exact_source_findings.account_lease_default_failover: AccountLease.run still switches account after failover-eligible errors; durable Core steps therefore require allow_failover=false while default Agent behavior remains unchanged.
exact_source_findings.outer_transport_retry: handle_openai_responses still has a separate single-account foreground TRANSPORT recursion after AccountPoolExhausted; protected Stage-B execution must suppress this after durable intent.
exact_source_findings.planner_correction: exact server still allows at most two deliberate correction provider steps after the initial step; these are product behavior and must remain on the same selected lease/account, each attempted once with implicit failover disabled.
exact_source_findings.ephemeral_cache_before_durable: exact server still checks TurnAffinity completion_text before the durable Stage-B replay path and reconstructs a new Responses payload with fresh IDs. Stage-B must make durable replay authoritative before any ephemeral completion cache hit.
exact_source_findings.pre_finalize_ephemeral_side_effects: exact server still reserves/clears foreground account and writes TurnAffinity before ConversationSegmentStore.put, then creates the final Responses payload only afterwards. The Stage-B candidate must reverse this ordering.
exact_source_findings.stream_precommit_leak: stream_openai_responses still allocates resp_/rs_ IDs and emits response/provider-derived events before durable publication; stream must become a projection of one canonical durable result.

gate_decision.reason: Stage-B exact server orchestration is not yet locally green; Windows semantics are not yet the last unknown.

next: Build the exact server Stage-B materializer around fresh blob f02cef6a... and the already-green V34/V35 store plus V39 account-pool opt-out; locally prove pool-unavailable, intent-write-failure, planner-correction, ambiguous transport, final-write-failure, exact retry/restart, compaction, stream and disconnect ordering before the single disposable Windows final gate.
